fusions.name: Spears Into the School
fusions.desc: Looses 3 barbed spears at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage. It holds 4 charges, and every kill you make gives one back.

fusions.name: Gaffed Straggler
fusions.desc: A thrown gaff that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Slipped Grasp
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you; transcendent damage still lands. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Wriggle and Return
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
